notes.title: Toaster Arena - 0.5.1 Alpha
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello everyone and welcome to another update post[/b][/h1]

This version addresses a lot of reported performance issues as the inclusion of shiny new stuff and tweaks to game-play.

[h2][b]Capture the Flag[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/3605ed1a3730cb449f69c7c59d600545b75fd500.jpg[/img]

On capture the flag, players must steal the enemy team's flag and deliver it to their base while protecting their own.

[h2][b]Updated big iron[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/aac276721f9e1e33a3ee082d9620c20b51bba899.jpg[/img]

The Gunslinger has received a new model and animations.

[h2][b]Cool hat[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/96768d5d86ab89690c25c9a0b485126ca232a9c4.png[/img]

[h2][b]List time!!![/b][/h2]

[h1]Additions[/h1]

[list]
[*] A simple kill cam spectator system has been added to the game.
[*] Execution mechanics have been added to the game, simply sneak behind someone and quick melee for a sick execution.
[*] New parkour trial level.
[*] Remastered and updated soundtracks.
[*] Added voice lines for raven.
[*] Added Runaway game-mode.
[*] Revolver TDM gamemode has been added.
[*] Polish to player hud elements.
[*] Added gamemode specific hud elements such as player score and flag markers.
[*] Polish work to first person animations.
[*] Added a cap hat cosmetic.
[*] Added a subtle camera shake when shooting weapons

[/list]


[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Third-person camera has been moved to be at the right shoulder instead of the top.
[*] Optimizations to armor loading to prevent hitches with player respawn.
[*] Reduced finger gun damage.
[*] Reduced carbine damage.
[*] Increased PDW damage.
[*] Decreased outlaw damage.
[*] Decreased AT sniper headshot damage to only 200.
[*] Changed opacity of damage indicator arrows.
[*] Overall improvements to emote systems to ensure consistency when playing and emote.
[*] Character voice lines are now synced.
[*] Toggle sprint option has been changed to always sprint.
[*] Player scoring is now based on whoever gave the last hit and no longer based on high damage.
[*] Overall changes to player movement systems to maintain momentum.
[*] Grim voice lines have been updated, thanks to Grim.
[*] Reactor and tower map updates by bruhvv.
[*] Proto axe materials changed to a flat red color.
[*] Game will now auto restart single player levels instead of waiting for player input.
[*] Viewing the scoreboard will no longer take away mouse input.
[*] Overall game system improvements.
[*] Pickup pad updates thanks to bruhvv.
[*] Fixes and tweaks to level bounds.

[*] Fixed player shields not being team colored on team game modes.
[*] Fixed issues with armor randomization not updating properly on some cases.
[*] Fixes to arena bot AI.
[*] Fixed weapon pads not giving players weapons.
[*] Fixed game modes not giving certain weapons to players.
[*] Fixed game not giving selected loadout weapons to players.
[*] Fixed AT sniper not performing head shot damage.
[*] Increased cone launcher projectile speed and splash damage radius.
[*] Increased plasma rifle damage and projectile speed.
[*] Increased crimson rifle damage and projectile speed.
[*] Fixed character death screams not following player ragdolls.
[*] Fixes to lipsync systems.
[*] Fixed max fps getting stuck at 500 instead of 700.
[*] Fixed soft lock upon pressing escape while talking to npc's.
[*] Fixes and tweaks to quick melee.
[*] Fixed bug that kept players on limbo on pressing kill bind during respawn
[*] Fixed sniper scopes not working on ultra wide monitors.
[*] Juggernaut gamemode has been fully fixed.

notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Toasters![/b][/h1]

Version 0.4.0 has been on the furnace for a while and it is time to finally push this version to live

This version includes a lot of new additions, QOL improvements, bug fixes and removal of some weapons.


So lets start now and go trough the list of changes!


[h2][b]Shiny![/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/52ec2869d167502f717cd269c8ecdbae9324ccb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/a2ba3251a5f7d784ca389e5beeb189d036f6611a.png[/img]

The game has been receiving updates regarding it's look, changes improve visibility while reducing screen flashing caused by weapons

[h2]
[b]They have skulls?[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/023e2491d11dbce33e060fe4f51ccd3afeece0ce.png[/img]

Characters will now have a visible skull behind the visor

Players can choose to have opaque visors that fully hide the skull or full on remove the visor to fully show them.

[h2]
[b]Raven's New Armor[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/052f078ff8695a89d297007f4285298671916768.png[/img]

Raven has received a new set of armor, this armor set is based on her old design

And yes the armor can be equipped by players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/7bb3c5af29ee70572165e011dc6618c9b0e0404d.png[/img]

Different materials can be selected for cosmetics.

These can range from a undersuit on the body to horns that can produce light.



[h2][b]Player damage has been changed[/b][/h2]

Weapon damage has received a full rework

Weapons wont deal bonus damage to players as long as they have shields, this means that head shot damage wont apply unless a sniper rifle is used or player shields have been destroyed

Due to this, weapon time to kill has been increased

notes.title: Toaster Arena - 0.3.0 Alpha
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions[/h1]


[list]
From the beginning Toaster Arena always used the NKD model base for the character models, however we felt that it would be more beneficial for the project in the long run to have it's own base character models.
Due to that a decision was taken to replace all of the character models for our in house version, this will allow use to have full ownership and control of what can be done with them.

Keep in mind that the game still uses the NKD character base as placeholders in some areas but will get replaced in future updates.

notes.title: Announcement: Debug Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]What is Debug mode?[/h1]

- [b]Debug mode is an experimental version of the game[/b] with latest features. It is intended for testing and debugging the game for non-developers.

[h1]Why should I use the Debug build?[/h1]

- By using the build, [b]you get the latest updated version of the game[/b], it has new features, fixes and improvements. However, [b]it can be more unstable than the stable branch.[/b] You can still join multiplayer games, but it is not compatible with server running on other branches.

[h1]How can I get the Debug build?[/h1]

- [b]Debug mode is available for everyone in the Beta tab in the game's Properties.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/c919b8a322b96e0e7bb15e1a1df085f5d396f097.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43841406/cf3ded2de15f2f89d0ba486ed5f10d936d2ff2a7.png[/img]

[h1]What if I run into bugs/have other issues with the branch/certain features?[/h1]

- [b]We urge you to join our server ( https://discord.gg/yBAevRtv4g ) and report any issues you encounter.[/b] If the branch has game breaking issues, simply switch back to the stable branch.

[h1]My lighting is messed up after changing to Debug, what do I do?[/h1]

- [b]The game starts by default on lowest settings, if the lighting is broken and is 'overly bright', simply change the Rendering Effects and Post-Processing to a higher setting.[/b]


[b]Thanks for playing![/b]
- Unselles

notes.title: Regarding the false information about the game and its developers.
notes.notes:
[h3]It is very important for us to keep the community well informed and stop the spread of false information about the current state of the game or the development team.[/h3]

It has come to us that certain individuals have been spreading false information in other communities, such as claiming to have worked on the project or attempt to defame us, only to seek attention and take credit for the project despite never contributing.

We want to remind you that [b]we have a credits section in the game that includes all developers and contributors that have their work present in the game.[/b] You can also [b][/b]find both of the main currently active developers on the Steam page.[b][/b]

We'd also like to point out that [b]we have a very active GitHub page that has all the contributors and individual contributions listed.[/b] There you can clearly see who has or hasn't worked on the project.

[url=https://discord.gg/yBAevRtv4g]OFFICIAL DISCORD SERVER[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: Toaster Arena - 0.2.0 Alpha
notes.notes:
Over the last months we have been working to further improve and enhance the game, bringing major changes such as the improved player controller, new HUD, better performance and rewriting existing and creating new systems.

[i]Please do keep in mind that the game is still in alpha and these changes are work-in-progress and will be completed in consequent updates.[/i]

[h1]Announcing the Toaster Arena Patreon Page[/h1]

We're currently developing the game with zero funding, which makes it difficult to dedicate time the project needs to grow further at a steady pace.

[b]If you enjoy the game and would like to support us, please consider pledging:[/b]

[h2][b][url=https://www.patreon.com/ToasterArena]https://www.patreon.com/ToasterArena[/url][/b][/h2]

You can support the development by choosing any of the Tiers presented, as of now only Tier 1 is available, additional tiers will be added in the future.

[b]Tier 1 rewards:[/b]
[list]
[*] In-game name with special color.
[*] In-game Patreon supporter icon.
[*] Your name being included in game's credit section.
[*] Patreon role on the Discord server.
[/list]

[i]All perks have to be set manually by the developers, you need to join the Discord server in order to receive these perks.[/i]



[h1]Additions[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Added new Global Post-process effects.[/b]
[*] [b]Tower Map added by [i]BRVVVH[/i].[/b]
[*] View model weapons will now tilt when a player slides or crouches.
[*] Third-person animations have been added for the Impact Grenade.
[*] Sprint toggle has been added.
[*] Credits section will now show Patreon user names.
[*] Patrons will be shown on the scoreboard with badges depending on pledged Tier.
[*] Developers will be shown on the scoreboard with a special developer badge.
[*] Added Patreon link in the main menu.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Player HUD has received a major rework.[/b]
[*] [b]Third-person debug camera has been optimized to not be as demanding.[/b]
[*] [b]First person arms rendering has been changed to no longer use a Picture-in-picture solution, this will improve performance by a great deal.[/b]
[*] [b]Player camera is no longer attached to the third-person character head, this gets rid of unwanted secondary movement on the camera.[/b]
[*] [b]Changes and reworks to lighting on all maps.[/b]
[*] [b]Weapons now properly support camera animations.[/b]
[*] [b]Huge chunk of sound effects have been replaced, this goes from weapon sounds to all the way to footsteps, this change is Work-in-Progress and will be expanded upon.[/b]
[*] [b]Screen Space Reflections have been enabled, you can turn these off by changing your settings.[/b]
[*] Golden Gun textures have been updated.
[*] Shield Recharge effect is no longer visible in first person.
[*] Green apple textures have been updated.
[*] Slide jump should now be more responsive.
[*] Grenades can now be throwed instantly.
[*] Vehicles respawn rate has been increased.
[*] Changes to passenger seats on the Crawler.
[*] Changes to Crawler's physics.
[*] Tweaks to Crawler's hitbox.
[*] Increased bullet capacity for the Green Apple.
[*] Increased Cobra Walker's speed.
[*] Changes to the Good Old Hawker.
[*] Scoreboard will now awards points to the highest damage dealer instead of last, this will get rid of 'point stealing'.
[*] Merc Health increased in Juggernaut Mode
[*] Protogen blood will now match glow colors.
[*] Bots now have the ability to jump.
[*] Changes to the UI font.
[*] Tweaks to weapon offsets.
[*] Shield hit particle system will now use the same color as glow color.
[*] Hunker Pistol animations have been changed.
[*] Green Apple received an addition animations pass.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixes to Hex input on color wheel.
[*] Fixed ability to slide on the floor if the angle was greater than 1 degree.
[*] Fixed sync on footstep sounds.
[*] Fixed material physics on props.
[*] Fixed thrown grenades not being destroyed after exploding.
[*] Fixed Gatling Gun using incorrect textures.
[*] Fixed unlocked achievements not showing up on the screen when unlocked.
[*] Fixed issue with player collision if a slide jump was performed.
[/list]
[i]Toaster Arena - 0.2.0 Alpha[/i]
